context: Kenji and Ren go to the music store; Kenji buys a small guitar.
purpose: Mentor and protégé shopping for an instrument.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: このギターの音色、ええなぁ。
lines.en: This guitar has a really nice tone to it.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried appreciation. Soft attack on the opening. Kansai lilt throughout — not theatrical, just natural. Lingers gently on the sound quality, like he's discovering it as he speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Yes — it really does have a warm quality.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, not performing. Soft, genuine. Small nod in the voice. He's observing alongside Kenji, not trying to impress — just noticing the same thing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もう一回、弾いてみよか。
lines.en: Let me play it one more time.
lines.style: Gentle, almost to himself. Kansai warmth without showiness. Quiet focus settling in. Hands already moving — the words are almost afterthought to the action.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: You're really good at this, Kenji-san.
lines.style: Soft, sincere admiration. No flattery in it — just straight observation from someone not used to compliments. Small pause before the name, like he's being careful to respect the moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ぼちぼちや、趣味やから。
lines.en: So-so — it's just a hobby for me.
lines.style: Kansai self-deprecation without apology. Light, warm deflection. The modesty is real but not weighty. Eyes probably down on the guitar, fingers moving gently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Are you thinking of buying it?
lines.style: Curious, open question. Soft, no pressure. Like he's genuinely wondering what Kenji's next move is — not probing, just asking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yeah — I've made up my mind on this one.
lines.style: Decisive but unhurried. Kansai warmth carrying quiet certainty. The decision is settled. Small smile in the voice — contentment at having found the right thing.
